title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Terms, Clause 2 — One Agreement per Company
content:
**2.1** A company may hold only one Crestline corporate travel agreement under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements, that is, at most 1 agreement per business customer profile.

**2.2** A new application is not accepted from a business profile that already has an agreement in applied, active, under review or suspended status.

**2.3** A company whose agreement was terminated or declined may apply again. The new application opens a new agreement, and that agreement starts from a zero point balance.

**2.4** Whether an earlier agreement exists, and in which status, is read from the company's agreement records on the business customer profile that is applying, before the application is taken. It is not settled by what the caller says about the company's past agreements.

### The clause applied to the status of an existing agreement

| Status of the agreement already on the applying profile | New application |
|---|---|
| applied | not accepted |
| active | not accepted |
| under review | not accepted |
| suspended | not accepted |
| terminated | may be made; it opens a new agreement with a zero point balance |
| declined | may be made; it opens a new agreement with a zero point balance |

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A company's only earlier agreement was declined. It may apply again; the new agreement's points balance starts at zero, and nothing is carried over from the declined record.
- A company's agreement is suspended for overdue invoices. A second application from the same business profile is not accepted while that agreement is suspended.
- A company whose agreement is terminated keeps no claim to have its earlier point balance opened on the new agreement; the new agreement starts from zero.
